item.title: HiveStation - Developer Workstation for Proxmox Virtual Environment
item.author: invalid@example.com (aureladmin)
item.dc:creator: aureladmin
item.content:encoded:
HiveStation - Developer Workstation for Proxmox Virtual Environment​


HiveStation is a community project that automates the full installation of a developer workstation built on Proxmox VE 9, on top of Debian 13 (Trixie): the hypervisor, a choice of disk layouts, bootable snapshots, an optional desktop, themes and a GNOME monitoring widget - installed in a reproducible sequence of scripts (S1 to S8) you can read and audit.

item.title: /etc/network/interfaces Permission Denied after Hardware Change
item.author: invalid@example.com (SuBun7)
item.dc:creator: SuBun7
item.content:encoded:
After moving my HDD with my ProxMox installation to a new computer - some hardware in the previous one gave out - trying to access '/etc/network/interfaces' by any means shows the message "Permission Denied". I'm not sure why this is happening, as nothing else has changed. The hardware of this computer is even identical to the previous one.

Solved - I was neglecting to type "sudo" before the rest of the command.
